sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:
At its core, Diggy is a match-3 puzzle game. Players are presented with a grid of gems, each with a specific point value. The goal is to create combinations of three or more gems in a row, either horizontally or vertically, to earn points and clear the board. Sounds simple, right? Well, it is, but it's also deceptively difficult. With new levels and challenges being added regularly, Diggy's gameplay is constantly evolving, keeping players on their toes.

One of the key mechanics that sets Diggy apart from other match-3 puzzle games is its use of special gems. These gems, which are marked with a star, have a higher point value than regular gems and can be used to complete combinations in a variety of ways. Some special gems can be used to clear entire rows or columns, while others can be used to create combinations of three or more gems in a single move.

But Diggy's gameplay isn't just about creating combinations. Players must also navigate obstacles and hazards, such as rocks and other debris, to reach the center of the moon. Each level has a unique set of obstacles that players must overcome, making each level feel distinct and challenging in its own way. Whether you're trying to create combinations or navigate obstacles, Diggy's core gameplay mechanics are engaging, challenging, and fun.

With its simple yet powerful gameplay, Diggy is accessible to players of all skill levels. Whether you're a seasoned gamer or a newcomer to the puzzle genre, you'll find Diggy's gameplay to be engaging and addictive. And with new levels and challenges being added regularly, there's always something new to look forward to. In short, Diggy's core gameplay mechanics are a key part of its charm, making it a must-play for anyone who loves the puzzle genre.
